events.label: Harvard alumni file brief supporting Harvard

slots.name: alumni count
slots.sentence: In July, more than 10,000 alumni, from members of the Class of 1950 to the Class of 2026, filed a brief in support of Harvard, arguing that “universities like Harvard can only manifest their mission, values, and foundational principles if they can operate with academic freedom.”
